name: agentgateway
description: Expert guide for agentgateway, the Linux Foundation AI-native proxy data plane for MCP tool federation, A2A proxying, and multi-provider LLM gateway routing, plus general traffic management, security, and observability.

interface.longDescription: Use agentgateway to configure MCP tool federation, A2A agent proxying, and multi-provider LLM routing, whether running standalone or installed on Kubernetes via Gateway API and CRDs.
defaultPrompt: Use agentgateway to federate multiple MCP servers behind one endpoint.
Use agentgateway to set up weighted or failover routing across LLM providers.
Use agentgateway to install on Kubernetes with the Gateway API and AgentgatewayPolicy CRDs.
